title: The teacher sees the whole class
owner: On the Class View, the teacher should be able to see everything and everyone. I as the teacher should be able to zoom in and see what's happening at anyone's farm, any town, all of it. Sure, players are limited by fog of war, but the teacher shouldn't be.

before.whatFilteredTheHost: projectWorld(world, undefined, 'host') has no household: entities filtered to householdId === undefined (none), land/wagon/work null or empty, and others = observedBy(world, undefined), which returns [] when there is no household. The Host page therefore drew roads, towns and homesteads from the public map (neighbours' houses as an assumed camp or house) and not one person. Zoom limits, /api/map and /api/woods were never refused to the Host.
before.hostSnapshotBytes: 1,974 bytes for a 30-family real-land class at tick 200

studentUnchanged.method: Before the change, every student projection of a 30-family real-land class (240 ticks) and a 15-family invented class (200 ticks), rolled and run by the neighbours, was hashed every 20 ticks; the same run after the change was compared.

tests.note: The first injection fails three tests, not one: the payload and wire tests both read the Host's whole class and cannot run without it. The student test was first written deriving the class from the Host's projection and also failed under that injection; it now reads the world directly and did not fail.
